channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Rodney Hood | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Rodney Hood from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Rodney Hood, Semi Ojeleye
item.description:
Mirjam Swanson:Ty Lue on the Zoom, on recent acquisitions Rodney Hood and Semi Ojeleye:

“They're pros ... they've been great, and so their opportunity is going to come.”

Tyronn Lue on Rodney Hood, Semi Ojeleye, Feb 27, 2022. Source: Twitter @MirjamSwanson.

item.title: Masai Ujiri on Rodney Hood
item.description:
Sean Highkin:Masai Ujiri:

“Rodney is more proven and Gary Trent is a 22-year-old with a ton of upside. Shooter, defender, he fits the core of our team. That's what we're excited about.”

Masai Ujiri on Rodney Hood, Mar 25, 2021. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: Terry Stotts on Rodney Hood
item.description:
Sean Highkin:Terry Stotts:

“Losing Rodney and Gary is tough. Good guys, good players, good teammates. When you go to the gym and enjoy the people that you're working with, you miss those guys.”

Terry Stotts on Rodney Hood, Mar 25, 2021. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: Michael Malone on Carmelo Anthony, Damian Lillard, CJ McCollum, Robert Covington, Rodney Hood, Jusuf Nurkic, Zach Collins
item.description:
Michael Malone on the Blazers, Denver's opponent tomorrow:

“I think Portland's really good. Last year they were decimated by injuries. I think Terry does a really good job as their coach. One of the best backcourts in the NBA with CJ McCollum and Damian Lillard, Carmelo Anthony, Jusuf Nurkic. They've got Rodney Hood back. Zach Collins back. They get Robert Covington. They're a good basketball team. I think they're going to have a much better season in the regular season than they had last year because they're going to be healthy.”

Michael Malone on Carmelo Anthony, Damian Lillard, CJ McCollum, Robert Covington, Rodney Hood, Jusuf Nurkic, Zach Collins, Dec 15, 2020. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Wesley Matthews on Rodney Hood
item.description:
Matthews expressed similar sentiments.

“When Rodney reached out to me, I took that as a compliment that the hard work that I put in to coming back on the court had paid off with my play and health,”

Wesley Matthews on Rodney Hood, Jun 16, 2020. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Neil Olshey on Rodney Hood
item.description:
Neil Olshey:

“Rodney is an accomplished NBA player that brings versatility, shot making and depth to our perimeter and will fit seamlessly into our culture and style of play.”

Neil Olshey on Rodney Hood, Feb 4, 2019. Source: Twitter @dwightjaynes.

item.title: Dennis Lindsey on Rodney Hood
item.description:
Andy Larsen:Dennis Lindsey:

“We believe Rodney Hood can be a primary scorer. It's time for us to pivot, it's time for us to move on.”

Dennis Lindsey on Rodney Hood, Jul 5, 2017. Source: Twitter @andyblarsen.

item.title: Deron Williams on Rodney Hood
item.description:
Deron Williams on shooting with 10 seconds left and the score tied, allowing the Jazz time for Rodney Hood's game-winner:

“At the end of the game like that, we have to get a shot with as little time [left] as possible, if not the clock going out. That's my fault as a point guard.”

Deron Williams on Rodney Hood, Dec 17, 2016. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Rodney Hood
item.description:
Tony Jones:Quin Snyder on Rodney Hood:

“We have five millennials now in the starting lineup. Rodney is going to get a lot of experience”

Quin Snyder on Rodney Hood, Dec 30, 2014. Source: Twitter @Tjonessltrib.

item.title: Mike Krzyzewski on Rodney Hood
item.description:
“Anybody's who's willing to take responsibility for his or her actions usually does better, and that's what Rodney does.”

Mike Krzyzewski on Rodney Hood, Mar 16, 2014. Source: The Chronicle.
